The Artist

Soulful.
Atmospheric.
Afro House.

Born in Zimbabwe, matured in the UK, and now based in Singapore for over a decade, TAKüRA brings a perspective that is simultaneously global and deeply local. His sets weave deep, soulful Afro House with rich melodic layers, building energy with intention and releasing it at exactly the right moment.

A holder of the WSET Level 2 Award in Wines, TAKüRA understands how to pair sound with a premium experience, making him a natural fit for members' clubs, rooftop bars, and luxury brand activations. He has played at 67 Pall Mall Singapore — one of the world's most prestigious members' wine clubs. Most recently he headlined the Andaz Singapore Gin Launch Party at Mr Stork at Andaz Singapore. His latest single Moto (Fire) is out now on Inner Moto, following Nditore and his debut Kumba.

New Single · Out Now

Moto (Fire)

Inner Moto · 2026

Moto means fire in Shona, and it is the name behind the label itself, making this one the heart of the project. The third TAKüRA single: Afro House with Shona vocals, released 3 July 2026.

Listen on all platforms

Second Single · Out Now

Nditore

Inner Moto · 2026

Shona for “take me.” Deep, melodic Afro House about loneliness and longing in a city you don’t belong to. Mbira textures, sub bass, and vocal lines that switch between Shona and English.

Listen on all platforms

Debut Single · Out Now

Kumba

Inner Moto · 2026

A deep Afro House groove built from the sonic memory of Zimbabwe. Mbira-inflected melodies, driving soulful percussion, and a dancefloor made for open skies.
